concept.title: Choose a Firefox policy to configure
concept.shortdesc: Choose policies by user outcome, schema channel, value shape, and the BPM surface that gives the safest edit path.

section.title: Start with the outcome
section.p: Begin with the browser behavior you need, such as updates, homepage, extensions, privacy, permissions, search, certificates, proxy, or AI and smart-feature controls. Then use the Firefox Policy Guide reference skeletons and User Guide workflows to find the stable policy ID.

section.title: Check Release and ESR support
section.p: Some policies exist in Firefox Release 153, ESR 153.0, ESR 140.13, and ESR 115.39, while others are available only in newer artifacts. Select the schema during profile preparation before relying on a policy. The saved editor shows that schema read-only; use explicit conversion to choose another schema. Treat an unavailable policy as a validation or conversion blocker rather than a documentation gap.

section.title: Pick the edit surface
section.p: Use Guided editor for common task-first choices, All settings for the full catalog and source tracing, and JSON editor when you need exact Firefox boundary document control. Each surface displays the prepared schema, preset, and CIS baseline read-only. Export only after validation is clean for that schema.

section.title: Review value shape
section.p: Simple boolean, string, and integer policies are usually safe to edit directly. Complex object, array, extension, permission, search, certificate, proxy, and preference-locking policies need extra review because nested fields, unknown preservation, and raw fallback can affect the exported policies.json.

section.title: Current 0.9.6 behavior
section.p: Schema, preset, and CIS baseline are selected during preparation and remain read-only in the editor. For another saved profile, use explicit conversion or duplicate preparation; an unsupported or blocked case never silently drops values. Guided owners are Step 2 for URLs/sites, Step 4 for certificates and trust, and Step 6 for extensions.
